metadata.title: Operating System Detection and Platform Adaptation

story.iWant: to automatically detect the user's operating system type and version
story.soThat: I can execute platform-specific installation and configuration processes
story.tasks: Task 1: Core OS Detection Module (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Subtask 1.1: Create OperatingSystemDetector class in core/environment_detector.py - Subtask 1.2: Implement Windows version detection (Windows 10/11) - Subtask 1.3: Implement macOS version detection (10.15+) - Subtask 1.4: Implement Linux distribution detection (Ubuntu 18.04+) - Subtask 1.5: Add architecture detection (x64, ARM64) Task 2: Platform-Specific Path Handling (AC: 4) - Subtask 2.1: Create path utilities for different platforms - Subtask 2.2: Implement file operation abstractions - Subtask 2.3: Handle path separators and case sensitivity Task 3: System Information Collection (AC: 5) - Subtask 3.1: Design system info data structure - Subtask 3.2: Collect hardware and software information - Subtask 3.3: Format system info for diagnostic use Task 4: Testing and Validation - Subtask 4.1: Create unit tests for OS detection - Subtask 4.2: Test on multiple platforms (mocked) - Subtask 4.3: Validate architecture detection accuracy

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Implement cross-platform operating system detection (Windows 10/11, macOS 10.15+, Ubuntu 18.04+) 2. Detect system architecture (x64, ARM64) and select corresponding installation packages 3. Verify system version compatibility and provide clear prompts for unsupported systems 4. Implement platform-specific path handling and file operations 5. Provide system information collection functionality for subsequent environment diagnostics

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR001: 脚本必须自动检测操作系统类型（Windows/macOS/Linux）并执行相应的安装和启动流程

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: 实现跨平台操作系统检测（Windows 10/11、macOS 10.15+、Ubuntu 18.04+）

code.reason: 现有的环境检测器类，包含系统信息检测逻辑
配置管理器，支持平台特定配置加载
文件工具函数，用于跨平台路径处理

constraints.constraint: 必须使用Python 3.8+作为运行环境
代码必须遵循项目架构中定义的模块化设计
平台特定配置必须通过config_manager.py加载
所有路径操作必须使用file_utils.py中的跨平台函数
错误处理必须使用统一的异常格式

interface.name: SystemInfo
interface.signature: @dataclass class SystemInfo: platform: str, architecture: str, version: str

tests.standards: 使用pytest进行单元测试，要求测试覆盖率达到80%以上。使用mock进行跨平台功能的模拟测试。所有测试必须支持异步操作测试。

ideas.idea: 测试Windows、macOS、Linux系统检测的准确性
测试系统版本兼容性验证逻辑
测试路径处理的跨平台兼容性
测试系统信息收集的完整性
